# TechPilot AI

> TechPilot AI publishes practical English-language guides about artificial intelligence tools, software, and everyday technology.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/): Overview of the site and its editorial focus.
- [About](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/about/): Mission, editorial approach, and contact information.
- [AI Tools](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/ai-tools/): Educational overview of AI tool categories and evaluation criteria.
- [How-To Guides](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/how-to/): Practical tutorials for using AI and technology responsibly.
- [Reviews](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/reviews/): Review and comparison framework, including strengths, limitations, privacy, and cost.
- [Contact](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/contact/): Contact the site.

## Published guides

- [Write Better AI Prompts](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/how-to/write-better-ai-prompts/): A practical method for improving prompts.
- [Verify AI-Generated Answers](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/how-to/verify-ai-answers/): Ways to check AI output before relying on it.
- [Protect Your Privacy When Using AI Tools](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/how-to/protect-privacy-using-ai/): Privacy-conscious AI use.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/privacy-policy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/terms/)
- [Disclaimer](https://techpilot-ai.pages.dev/disclaimer/)

## Editorial notes

Content is educational and may become outdated as tools change. Verify current product details with their official providers. Do not treat AI-generated output or general educational material as professional advice.
